name: J. B. Danquah
contribution: A Ghanaian politician, scholar, anglophile, lawyer and statesman.

checks.lead: Joseph Kwame Kyeretwie Boakye Danquah (18 December 1895 – 4 February 1965) was a Ghanaian politician, scholar, anglophile, lawyer and statesman. He was a politician in pre and post-colonial Ghana, which was formerly the Gold Coast.
